glosses: denoting, marking, indicating (by means of a long line or track)

examples.text: На другом конце провода никого нет.
examples.en: There was no one on the other end of the line.

examples.text: Какой провод резать: красный или белый?
examples.en: Which wire should I cut, the red one or the white one?
We'll have to separate the wires.
